analysis-frequency.name: Flood Frequency Analysis (Design Flood)
analysis-frequency.intro: Fit a flood series to a frequency curve and read off design peak flow and volume for return periods such as 20, 50 and 100 years, for flood-control planning and spillway design.

area-capacity.name: Reservoir Capacity Curve Fitting
area-capacity.intro: Enter water-level/area pairs to fit a level-capacity curve by trapezoidal integration, and query the storage volume at any water level for reservoir operation and water-supply planning.

assessor-22.name: Water-Saving Fixture / Water Efficiency Assessor
assessor-22.intro: Grade a water fixture against national water-efficiency levels from its measured flow, and compare daily and annual water use against the old fixture, with per-person savings, to support retrofit decisions.

assessor-33.name: Hydraulic Energy Efficiency & Recovery Assessor
assessor-33.intro: Calculate hydraulic pump volumetric, mechanical and overall efficiency, and assess potential-energy recovery rate and VFD energy savings from load, height and duty cycle.

bernoulli-velocity.name: Bernoulli Equation Calculator (Downstream Velocity)
bernoulli-velocity.intro: Solve downstream velocity v2 from upstream/downstream pressure, known velocity and elevation by Bernoulli energy conservation, and read the total head difference between two points.

calc-1.name: Pipe Hydraulics Calculator (Velocity / Pressure Drop)
calc-1.intro: Compute circular-pipe velocity, Reynolds number, friction loss and pressure drop by the Darcy-Weisbach equation, including local-loss terms, for room-temperature clean water.

calc-2.name: Pump Head Calculator
calc-2.intro: From suction and discharge static heads plus friction and minor losses, calculate the total pump head required, for pump selection in water-supply and drainage systems.

calc-26.name: Open Channel Uniform Flow Calculator (Manning's Equation)
calc-26.intro: For a trapezoidal channel, apply Manning's equation to compute uniform-flow discharge and velocity (set side slope m = 0 for a rectangular section).

calc-3.name: Pipe Friction Head Loss Calculator
calc-3.intro: Compute circular-pipe friction head loss, pressure drop and flow velocity by the Hazen-Williams formula, supporting common flow and diameter unit choices.

calc-4.name: Orifice Flow Calculator
calc-4.intro: Enter head, orifice diameter and discharge coefficient to compute orifice discharge flow, for water supply, drainage and hydraulic design.

calc-5.name: Siphon Height Calculator
calc-5.intro: Estimate the maximum allowable siphon height that avoids cavitation at the pump inlet, from local atmospheric pressure, water temperature and pipe losses.

calc-54.name: Sluice Gate Open/Close Force Calculator
calc-54.intro: From gate self-weight, upstream/downstream head difference, seal friction coefficient and water-column downforce, calculate opening and closing forces to check hoist capacity.

calc-flow-1.name: Vacuum Generator Flow Calculator
calc-flow-1.intro: Size a vacuum generator and suction cups from cup diameter, cup count, vacuum level, air-supply pressure, safety factor and target response time, with gripping force and required flow.

calc-power-2.name: Cooling Heat Exchange Power Calculator
calc-power-2.intro: From coolant flow and inlet/outlet temperature difference, compute heat-exchange power (kW) by specific heat, and back-calculate the cooling-water flow needed to hold that load.

calc-pressure.name: Pipe Diameter Calculator (Gravity / Pressure Flow)
calc-pressure.intro: Determine the required pipe diameter for pressure flow (Hazen-Williams) or gravity flow (Manning) from design flow, water temperature, pipe length and material, and recommend the next standard DN.

calc-pressure-capacity.name: Accumulator Capacity Calculator
calc-pressure-capacity.intro: From working pressure range, gas pre-charge pressure and oil volume change, size a bladder accumulator under isothermal or adiabatic assumptions for shock absorption, leakage make-up or auxiliary power.

calc-protection.name: Water Hammer Protection Calculator
calc-protection.intro: Judge direct or indirect water hammer from valve-closure time versus wave travel time, compute the pressure rise, check pipeline safety and advise on slow-closing valves, surge tanks or air valves.

calc-speed.name: Pneumatic Cylinder Force & Speed Calculator
calc-speed.intro: From bore, stroke, air pressure, load, exhaust port size and rod diameter, calculate pneumatic cylinder push/pull force, piston speed, cycle time and cushioning adequacy.

calc-speed-itinerary.name: Hydraulic Cylinder Force, Speed & Stroke Calculator
calc-speed-itinerary.intro: From bore, rod diameter, supply pressure and flow of a double-acting single-rod cylinder, compute thrust and pull force, piston speed and stroke time for machine design and cycle-time checks.

continuity-pipe.name: Continuity Equation Calculator (Pipe Reducer)
continuity-pipe.intro: Apply A1v1 = A2v2 to find the velocity after a pipe diameter change from the inlet area/velocity and the outlet area.

cycle-19.name: Pneumatic Maintenance Cycle Planner (Drain / Oil / Service)
cycle-19.intro: Plan drain, lubrication and service cycles for pneumatic components by element type and cycle length, generated as a maintenance calendar with due-date reminders.

dam-stability.name: Dam Stability Calculator
dam-stability.intro: From unit-length gravity-dam geometry, concrete unit weight, upstream water level and foundation parameters, compute anti-sliding and anti-overturning safety factors under static water pressure.

daohongxi-shuitousunshi-maishen.name: Inverted Siphon Head Loss & Burial Depth
daohongxi-shuitousunshi-maishen.intro: Estimate the head loss and required burial depth of an inverted siphon from pipe diameter, flow and terrain, for farmland water conservancy and water-supply crossings.

darcy-head-loss.name: Darcy-Weisbach Head Loss Calculator
darcy-head-loss.intro: Compute pipe friction pressure drop by dP = f(L/D)(rho v^2/2) from friction factor, pipe length and diameter, fluid density and velocity.

density-4.name: Earth-Rock Dam Fill Density Control
density-4.intro: From wet density, water content and maximum dry density, compute compacted dry density and degree of compaction and check it against specification for earth-rock dam and embankment fill.

detector-22.name: Oil Cleanliness Classifier (ISO 4406 / NAS 1638)
detector-22.intro: Enter particle counts by size range per 100 mL of oil to automatically classify ISO 4406 and NAS 1638 cleanliness codes and suggest suitable applications for each level.

flow.name: Spillway Discharge Calculator
flow.intro: Compute spillway discharge capacity by the weir-flow formula Q = m*b*sqrt(2g)*H^(3/2) for ogee or broad-crested weirs, for flood routing and outlet-works checks.

flow-1.name: Ecological Minimum Release Flow Calculator
flow-1.intro: Compute the ecological minimum release flow from long-term mean flow and a base-flow coefficient, and assess ecological status with the Tennant method, for instream-flow management.

flow-pipeline.name: Diversion Pipeline Sizing Calculator
flow-pipeline.intro: From design diversion flow and economic velocity, calculate the recommended pipe diameter and estimate friction head loss by Manning, balancing investment and pumping energy.

flow-power.name: Hydropower Output Calculator
flow-power.intro: From net head, diversion flow and turbine/generator efficiencies, compute electrical output and, with annual utilisation hours, estimate annual generation for small hydropower appraisal.

flow-rate.name: Flow Rate Calculator
flow-rate.intro: Calculate pipe flow (Q = A x v from area and mean velocity) or open-channel flow (Manning from bed slope, roughness and hydraulic radius) to estimate a section conveyance capacity.

flow-velocity.name: Flow Velocity Calculator
flow-velocity.intro: Compute mean velocity in an open channel by Manning's equation and classify the flow regime by Reynolds number (laminar/transitional/turbulent) and Froude number (subcritical/supercritical).

gear-1.name: Hydraulic Pump Selection
gear-1.intro: From required system flow, working pressure and pump speed, calculate displacement and recommend a suitable pump type (gear / vane / piston) for hydraulic system matching.

hazen-williams-headloss.name: Hazen-Williams Head Loss Calculator
hazen-williams-headloss.intro: Compute head loss h_f = 10.67*L*Q^1.852/(C^1.852*D^4.87) from flow, pipe length, roughness coefficient C and diameter (SI units).

lifespan.name: Hydraulic Seal Selection & Lifespan
lifespan.intro: From working pressure, temperature, medium and speed, recommend seal material (NBR / FKM / PU) and type (O-ring / Yx-ring / Glyd ring) and estimate seal service life for maintenance planning.

manning-flow.name: Manning Open Channel Flow Calculator
manning-flow.intro: Compute open-channel uniform-flow discharge Q = (1/n)*A*R^(2/3)*sqrt(S) from roughness n, cross-sectional area A, hydraulic radius R and bed slope S.

mianbanduishibachenjiangyuce.name: CFRD Settlement Predictor
mianbanduishibachenjiangyuce.intro: Predict construction-period and post-completion settlement of a concrete-face rockfill dam by layer-wise summation and an exponential consolidation model, from dam height, modulus, unit weight and consolidation parameters.

minor-head-loss.name: Minor Head Loss Calculator
minor-head-loss.intro: Compute local head loss h_L = K*v^2/(2g) for valves, elbows and fittings from the loss coefficient K and velocity.

power-3.name: Pump Station Efficiency Calculator
power-3.intro: From flow, head and shaft power, compute pump effective power, operating efficiency and energy use and cost (water density 1000 kg/m3, g = 9.81 m/s2).

power-torque.name: Hydraulic Motor Selection
power-torque.intro: From required torque, speed and system pressure difference, calculate motor displacement, required flow and power and recommend a motor type.

pressure-diagnosis.name: Hydraulic Fault Diagnosis
pressure-diagnosis.intro: Diagnose likely hydraulic faults from rated and measured pressure, internal leakage, dominant vibration frequency and oil temperature, with rule-based causes and repair advice.

pressure-drop.name: Pipeline Design (Wall Thickness / Velocity / Pressure Drop)
pressure-drop.intro: Estimate pipeline friction pressure drop and check wall thickness from diameter, velocity and length, for industrial piping and hydraulic system design.

pressure-flow-1.name: Hydraulic Valve Selection
pressure-flow-1.intro: From maximum flow, working pressure, control mode and valve function, calculate the valve bore and recommend a suitable valve type and size.

pump-power.name: Pump Power Calculator
pump-power.intro: Compute pump shaft (input) power by P = rho*g*Q*H/eta from fluid density, gravity, flow, head and efficiency.

qudao-buchong-buyu-liusu.name: Canal Non-Scouring / Non-Silting Velocity
qudao-buchong-buyu-liusu.intro: Estimate the reasonable non-scouring and non-silting velocity range for a canal from section geometry and roughness, for open-channel design and scour/silt checks.

ratio-24.name: Hydraulic Servo System Calculator
ratio-24.intro: From load mass, stroke, response frequency and supply pressure, calculate servo-cylinder area, required flow, hydraulic natural frequency and servo-valve flow gain to assess system bandwidth.

rectangular-weir.name: Rectangular Sharp-Crested Weir Calculator
rectangular-weir.intro: Compute weir discharge Q = (2/3)*Cd*b*sqrt(2g)*H^1.5 from discharge coefficient, weir width and head over the crest.

shenliu-jinrunxian-weizhi.name: Seepage Line (Phreatic Line) Position
shenliu-jinrunxian-weizhi.intro: Estimate the phreatic line position and seepage exit point of an earth dam from dam parameters and permeability coefficient, for stability and seepage-control design.

speed-pressure.name: Hydraulic Circuit Design
speed-pressure.intro: From cylinder bore and rod diameter, load and required speed, calculate push/pull chamber areas, required pressure and flow to design circuit pressure and flow parameters.

spillway-calc.name: Spillway Calculator
spillway-calc.intro: Compute spillway discharge Q by the weir-flow formula from weir type, head over crest, width and composite discharge coefficient, for quick flood-release checks.

temp-7.name: Concrete Thermal Cracking Prevention
temp-7.intro: From placing temperature, ambient temperature, hydration heat rise and structure thickness, compute internal-external and base temperature differences and the anti-cracking safety factor.

tester-blast.name: Pressure Vessel Pressure Test & Safety Assessment
tester-blast.intro: From design and working pressure, material tensile and yield strength, vessel bore and wall thickness, compute test pressure, hold time, burst pressure and safety factor per pressure-vessel rules.

velocity-from-flow.name: Velocity from Flow Rate Calculator
velocity-from-flow.intro: Compute mean velocity v = Q/A from volumetric flow and cross-sectional area, for pipes and channels, to check velocity against specification limits.

water-level.name: Water Level Calculator
water-level.intro: From piezometric head, velocity and elevation, split position, pressure and velocity head and sum total head by Bernoulli, for pressure-tap analysis and pump-suction teaching.

yeyayouxiangsheji.name: Hydraulic Tank Designer
yeyayouxiangsheji.intro: From pump flow, working pressure, system efficiency and allowable temperature rise, size the hydraulic reservoir volume and heat-dissipation area and judge whether a cooler is needed.

yuji-nisha-kurongsunshi.name: Reservoir Sedimentation Loss Estimator
yuji-nisha-kurongsunshi.intro: Estimate reservoir storage loss from sediment inflow, capacity and desilting parameters, for reservoir operation and service-life assessment.
